8e1c657623526542f134.en: In an active sentence, the subject does the action.
8e1c657623526542f134.id: Dalam kalimat aktif (active sentence), subjek (subject) melakukan perbuatannya.

8a199525996ee40cfbaf.en: In a passive sentence, the subject has the action done to it.
8a199525996ee40cfbaf.id: Dalam kalimat pasif (passive sentence), subjek dikenai perbuatannya.

7ca7728791f846646271.en: The passive uses a form of be with a past participle.
7ca7728791f846646271.id: Kalimat pasif memakai salah satu bentuk be bersama past participle.

9d1f3f238c165d00d41b.en: Use the passive when the doer is unknown or less important than the action.
9d1f3f238c165d00d41b.id: Pakai kalimat pasif bila pelakunya tidak diketahui atau kurang penting dibanding perbuatannya.

f7039b60cd2cf224a64c.en: Science reports and formal writing often use the passive.
f7039b60cd2cf224a64c.id: Laporan sains dan tulisan resmi sering memakai kalimat pasif.

72d32b4bc5038892f861.en: The letters were delivered is passive: the letters received the action.
72d32b4bc5038892f861.id: The letters were delivered adalah kalimat pasif (passive): surat-surat itu menerima tindakan.

41133a8ce0fb1ef5e485.en: The postman does the action, so this is active.
41133a8ce0fb1ef5e485.id: The postman yang melakukan tindakan, jadi kalimat ini aktif.

e1d33fe4f0614051d0f4.en: This describes the postman. No action is done to anyone.
e1d33fe4f0614051d0f4.id: Kalimat ini menjelaskan the postman. Tidak ada tindakan yang dikenakan kepada siapa pun.

5640f5311cfde96f1776.en: We do the action, so this is active.
5640f5311cfde96f1776.id: We yang melakukan tindakan, jadi kalimat ini aktif.

8174c9776004e8a2b64d.en: The windows are cleaned every Friday is passive: are + cleaned.
8174c9776004e8a2b64d.id: The windows are cleaned every Friday adalah kalimat pasif: are + cleaned.

3f8ba2ccb742940e1d63.en: In The window was broken by the ball, the window receives the action. Was broken is a passive verb.
3f8ba2ccb742940e1d63.id: Pada The window was broken by the ball, the window menerima tindakan. Was broken adalah kata kerja pasif (passive verb).

4a45a5e36700c123b429.en: The ball does the action, so this is active.
4a45a5e36700c123b429.id: The ball yang melakukan tindakan, jadi kalimat ini aktif.

907f3ccea67c03419df3.en: This describes the window. No action is done to it.
907f3ccea67c03419df3.id: Kalimat ini menjelaskan the window. Tidak ada tindakan yang dikenakan pada benda itu.

6d714884b802468ec506.en: The children do the action, so this is active.
6d714884b802468ec506.id: The children yang melakukan tindakan, jadi kalimat ini aktif.

cbc850118cd5921073d4.en: In active sentences the subject does the action, as in The chef cooked the rice. In passive sentences the subject receives the action, as in The rice was cooked.
cbc850118cd5921073d4.id: Pada kalimat aktif (active), subjek melakukan tindakan, seperti pada The chef cooked the rice. Pada kalimat pasif (passive), subjek menerima tindakan, seperti pada The rice was cooked.

1ad2babd42c8c27a612d.en: Was eaten is the past passive. The cake received the action, and the children did it.
1ad2babd42c8c27a612d.id: Was eaten adalah bentuk pasif masa lampau (past passive). The cake menerima tindakan, dan the children yang melakukannya.

1c0778ff5ae32fcc9d78.en: The tree received the action, so it becomes the subject: The old tree was struck by lightning.
1c0778ff5ae32fcc9d78.id: The tree menerima tindakan, jadi the tree menjadi subjek: The old tree was struck by lightning.

c06eee2565dcafc6b824.en: This changes the meaning: now the tree does the striking.
c06eee2565dcafc6b824.id: Kalimat ini mengubah maknanya: sekarang the tree yang menyambar.

cb0d1029adb9d6643425.en: This changes who did the action.
cb0d1029adb9d6643425.id: Kalimat ini mengubah siapa yang melakukan tindakan.

348ba533f62a24727b4d.en: This is active and changes the meaning.
348ba533f62a24727b4d.id: Kalimat ini aktif dan mengubah maknanya.

e44bfe88aaaf2738bb03.en: In the active sentence, Laila does the action: Laila designed the poster.
e44bfe88aaaf2738bb03.id: Pada kalimat aktif, Laila melakukan tindakan: Laila designed the poster.

ac483268a00d4cbe17d1.en: Science reports focus on the method and results. The passive voice keeps attention on what was done, not on the person who did it.
ac483268a00d4cbe17d1.id: Laporan sains berfokus pada cara kerja dan hasilnya. Kalimat pasif (passive voice) membuat perhatian tertuju pada apa yang dilakukan, bukan pada orang yang melakukannya.

bbe643b178e663b57d2f.en: Science reports are not meant to be funny.
bbe643b178e663b57d2f.id: Laporan sains tidak ditulis untuk melucu.

7fb298038a8d669b55fd.id: Was heated adalah bentuk lampau (past tense).

b5d12ec1abea6808e2c7.en: Active sentences about water are also correct.
b5d12ec1abea6808e2c7.id: Kalimat aktif tentang air juga benar.

67ecb1fb454a9d2bb17b.en: Nobody knows who left the gate open, so the passive voice lets the writer leave out the doer.
67ecb1fb454a9d2bb17b.id: Tidak ada yang tahu siapa yang membiarkan gerbang terbuka, jadi kalimat pasif membuat penulis bisa tidak menyebut pelakunya.

cbabae2417e97714f04b.en: We know who won: our team.
cbabae2417e97714f04b.id: Kita tahu siapa yang menang: our team.

e06362a8130d8c485d9c.en: We know who sang it: Dina.
e06362a8130d8c485d9c.id: Kita tahu siapa yang menyanyikannya: Dina.

7495e85213d706cd0e5d.en: In the passive, the one being chased becomes the subject, and the tense must stay the same: chased, is chasing and will chase each have their own passive form.
7495e85213d706cd0e5d.id: Pada kalimat pasif, yang dikejar menjadi subjek, dan tense harus tetap sama: chased, is chasing, dan will chase masing-masing punya bentuk pasifnya sendiri.

ebe3dbc7c536889f6337.en: Has eaten becomes have been eaten in the passive, because biscuits is plural: All the biscuits have been eaten.
ebe3dbc7c536889f6337.id: Has eaten menjadi have been eaten dalam bentuk pasif, karena biscuits berbentuk jamak (plural): All the biscuits have been eaten.

c5368db68c3dc8df30c6.en: The parcel had arrived early is active: the parcel did the arriving. Had arrived is the past perfect, and there is no form of be.
c5368db68c3dc8df30c6.id: The parcel had arrived early adalah kalimat aktif: the parcel sendiri yang tiba. Had arrived adalah past perfect, dan tidak ada bentuk be di sana.

45a43c64d8e003dd4f19.en: This is passive: was being repaired.
45a43c64d8e003dd4f19.id: Kalimat ini pasif: was being repaired.

6483a4f74b2d270b93d6.en: This is passive: have been announced.
6483a4f74b2d270b93d6.id: Kalimat ini pasif: have been announced.

5301445453f6e03b6e7e.en: In an active sentence the subject does the action. The goalkeeper does the catching.
5301445453f6e03b6e7e.id: Pada kalimat aktif, subjek melakukan tindakan. The goalkeeper yang menangkap.

72b3106c13b5d6a12eea.en: Here the ball receives the action, so this is passive.
72b3106c13b5d6a12eea.id: Di sini the ball yang menerima tindakan, jadi kalimat ini pasif.

f8e885a7fa19335ab3e5.en: The ball receives the action, so this is passive.
f8e885a7fa19335ab3e5.id: The ball yang menerima tindakan, jadi kalimat ini pasif.

6888741414aab17bd65b.en: The ball receives the action. Was kicked is the passive verb and by Leo names the doer.
6888741414aab17bd65b.id: The ball menerima tindakan. Was kicked adalah kata kerja pasif, dan by Leo menyebut pelakunya.

05f08b174c5c41638ee7.en: In the passive, be agrees with the subject. The bridge was built and the roads were repaired.
05f08b174c5c41638ee7.id: Pada kalimat pasif, be harus cocok dengan subjeknya. The bridge was built dan the roads were repaired.

b91c7865bf1fccb3c597.en: The passive is formed with was plus the past participle: The mural was painted by Dewi.
b91c7865bf1fccb3c597.id: Kalimat pasif dibentuk dengan was ditambah past participle: The mural was painted by Dewi.

f52ee055b3aef53dd527.en: Passive sentences are often used for steps in a process. The steps happen in this order.
f52ee055b3aef53dd527.id: Kalimat pasif sering dipakai untuk langkah-langkah dalam suatu proses. Langkah-langkahnya terjadi dengan urutan ini.

6e9e92b5feefae46ba47.en: Keep the same tense. Harvest is present, so the passive is is harvested.
6e9e92b5feefae46ba47.id: Pakai tense yang sama. Harvest berbentuk present, jadi bentuk pasifnya adalah is harvested.

3f27f2a278aec2c3cadf.en: The tense has changed. The original sentence is in the present.
3f27f2a278aec2c3cadf.id: Bentuk waktunya (tense) berubah. Kalimat aslinya memakai bentuk sekarang (present).

98bb3b7baa6506b5ef63.en: The passive needs a form of be before harvested.
98bb3b7baa6506b5ef63.id: Kalimat pasif memerlukan bentuk be sebelum harvested.

ef07d2d302e6a4864637.en: The farmers and the rice have swapped roles, so the meaning has changed.
ef07d2d302e6a4864637.id: The farmers dan the rice bertukar peran, jadi maknanya berubah.

872869488218ddafd90f.en: The passive needs the past participle. For win it is won.
872869488218ddafd90f.id: Kalimat pasif memerlukan past participle. Untuk win, bentuknya won.

fdba4534d6eed336a523.en: In a passive sentence you can say who did the action with by, or you can leave it out.
fdba4534d6eed336a523.id: Pada kalimat pasif, kamu bisa menyebut siapa yang melakukan tindakan dengan by, atau tidak menyebutnya.

b09a6f3417c646988d23.en: The future passive is will be plus the past participle: will be given out.
b09a6f3417c646988d23.id: Bentuk pasif masa depan adalah will be ditambah past participle: will be given out.

e0315769fe85b2c0a306.en: This is passive, but it is in the past.
e0315769fe85b2c0a306.id: Kalimat ini pasif, tetapi menceritakan masa lampau.

16efa2e08baa1c0df085.en: This is about the future, but it is active.
16efa2e08baa1c0df085.id: Kalimat ini tentang masa depan, tetapi aktif.

ad366056883ababd7d84.en: This is not passive. The verb needs be before given.
ad366056883ababd7d84.id: Kalimat ini tidak pasif. Kata kerjanya memerlukan be sebelum given.

4f64f1cddb196636332e.en: The passive sentences are Tom has been chosen, Rice is grown, and The match will be played.
4f64f1cddb196636332e.id: Kalimat pasifnya adalah Tom has been chosen, Rice is grown, dan The match will be played.

ae7658354275af7da079.en: The storm does the action, so this is active.
ae7658354275af7da079.id: The storm yang melakukan tindakan, jadi kalimat ini aktif.

73107090dc4566531410.en: Wulan does the action, so this is active.
73107090dc4566531410.id: Wulan yang melakukan tindakan, jadi kalimat ini aktif.

2597d5bceaac3a0ae778.en: Present perfect passive is has or have been plus the past participle: has been swept.
2597d5bceaac3a0ae778.id: Present perfect passive adalah has atau have been ditambah past participle: has been swept.

9b04325970e76ec7a79e.en: This changes the tense. Have swept is present perfect, and was swept is simple past.
9b04325970e76ec7a79e.id: Kalimat ini mengubah bentuk waktunya (tense). Have swept adalah present perfect, dan was swept adalah simple past.

8fdc11a6d58a285e1b89.en: The passive needs been before the past participle.
8fdc11a6d58a285e1b89.id: Kalimat pasif memerlukan been sebelum past participle.

a6a3d2da19d2a2af4f04.en: This changes the tense to present continuous.
a6a3d2da19d2a2af4f04.id: Kalimat ini mengubah bentuk waktunya menjadi present continuous.

a747ffd6e4568c61eea5.en: Has been repaired by the workers becomes the workers have repaired. The tense stays present perfect.
a747ffd6e4568c61eea5.id: Has been repaired by the workers menjadi the workers have repaired. Tense tetap present perfect.

c8ac41e06617163d45c4.en: The writer puts the temple first because the temple is the focus. The workers are still named at the end.
c8ac41e06617163d45c4.id: Penulis menaruh the temple di depan karena candi itu menjadi fokusnya. The workers tetap disebut di akhir.

d6af16b0bbc3c262839e.en: The workers are named in the sentence, as teams of skilled workers.
d6af16b0bbc3c262839e.id: Para pekerja itu disebut dalam kalimat, yaitu teams of skilled workers.

efd1c446ec7f7d13c4c1.en: Neither voice is always better. It depends on what you want to focus on.
efd1c446ec7f7d13c4c1.id: Kalimat aktif dan kalimat pasif tidak ada yang selalu lebih baik. Semuanya tergantung pada hal yang ingin kamu tonjolkan.

a1e1faaa728c0fb1b430.en: The verb was restored is in the past, not the future.
a1e1faaa728c0fb1b430.id: Kata kerja was restored menunjukkan masa lampau, bukan masa depan.

a8472a246395056980e9.en: Modal passive is the modal verb plus be plus the past participle: must be cleaned.
a8472a246395056980e9.id: Modal passive adalah modal verb ditambah be ditambah past participle: must be cleaned.

844f0a7e5843c8dd95f8.en: It carried should be it was carried. The passive needs a form of be before the past participle.
844f0a7e5843c8dd95f8.id: It carried seharusnya it was carried. Kalimat pasif memerlukan bentuk be sebelum past participle.

155e08d90d99800cb752.en: This sentence is correct. It has was before baked.
155e08d90d99800cb752.id: Kalimat ini benar. Ada was sebelum baked.

4c93e8b536441ea10ffa.en: This sentence is correct. It has were before bought.
4c93e8b536441ea10ffa.id: Kalimat ini benar. Ada were sebelum bought.

b5bfb10bfd4d607ad1e4.en: One sentence is passive but has no form of be.
b5bfb10bfd4d607ad1e4.id: Ada satu kalimat pasif yang tidak punya bentuk be.

68b1c3e93f55df48e883.en: Rose has no object, so nothing can receive the action. Only verbs with an object can become passive.
68b1c3e93f55df48e883.id: Rose tidak punya objek, jadi tidak ada yang bisa menerima tindakan. Hanya kata kerja yang punya objek yang bisa menjadi pasif.

b016ecd31e58b8ebe39d.en: Opened has an object, the window, so it can become The window was opened.
b016ecd31e58b8ebe39d.id: Opened punya objek, yaitu the window, jadi kalimat ini bisa menjadi The window was opened.

d13fb2829a1f5e2c97f8.en: Kicked has an object, the ball, so it can become The ball was kicked.
d13fb2829a1f5e2c97f8.id: Kicked punya objek, yaitu the ball, jadi kalimat ini bisa menjadi The ball was kicked.

0c638882416f0092572c.en: Chased has an object, the mouse, so it can become The mouse was chased.
0c638882416f0092572c.id: Chased punya objek, yaitu the mouse, jadi kalimat ini bisa menjadi The mouse was chased.

5ee8975dbc6150bfa677.en: In an active sentence, the subject does the action. The dog is doing the chasing.
5ee8975dbc6150bfa677.id: Pada kalimat aktif, subjek melakukan tindakan. The dog yang mengejar.

2c48be50ad27f9c2fc2b.en: The cake receives the action, so the sentence is passive.
2c48be50ad27f9c2fc2b.id: The cake menerima tindakan, jadi kalimat itu pasif.

901a16c9e8bf813b2000.en: The window receives the action. The ball did the breaking.
901a16c9e8bf813b2000.id: The window menerima tindakan. The ball yang memecahkannya.

6ea3bd9e048337842718.en: The correct passive sentence is The picture was painted by Sara. The object of the active sentence becomes the subject.
6ea3bd9e048337842718.id: Kalimat pasif yang benar adalah The picture was painted by Sara. Objek pada kalimat aktif menjadi subjek.

c0f58ddc1524c21bdb73.en: A passive sentence can leave out who did the action, which is useful when it is not known.
c0f58ddc1524c21bdb73.id: Kalimat pasif boleh tidak menyebut siapa yang melakukan tindakan, dan ini berguna kalau pelakunya tidak diketahui.

9012432823079a6c6c0b.en: In an active sentence the subject does the action. In a passive sentence the subject receives it.
9012432823079a6c6c0b.id: Pada kalimat aktif, subjek melakukan tindakan. Pada kalimat pasif, subjek menerima tindakan itu.

935351b6661ff7331070.en: The ball receives the action, so the sentence is passive.
935351b6661ff7331070.id: The ball menerima tindakan, jadi kalimat itu pasif.
